title.from: Inspect newsletter messages and manage confirmation or unsubscribe manually
title.to: Inspect newsletter messages and control subscription actions

description.from:
Design-only planning requested by Ryan during voice. Implementation remains unstarted; no code, infrastructure, deployment, purchase or publishing authorization is implied. Initial status stays open (Discovery), unassigned.

As a publication user, I want a usable newsletter inbox for my provided inbound address, so that I can read original messages and manage subscriptions while understanding intake results.

Acceptance behavior (planned, not executable or verified yet):
```gherkin
Feature: Inspect newsletter messages and manage confirmation or unsubscribe manually
  Scenario: Read a scoped newsletter inbox
    Given an authorized publication or user has a provided inbound address
    When I open its newsletter inbox or reader
    Then I can inspect original readable messages with sender and received date
    And each message shows derived References and their source provenance
    And processing status, pending work and errors are visible
    And another publication or user's private messages are not exposed
    And hidden ingestion without this reader does not satisfy provided-address delivery
  Scenario: Manage subscription actions deliberately
    Given a message contains a confirmation, unsubscribe, preferences or other account-action link
    When the Monitor scans or processes the message
    Then it does not activate the action link automatically
    When the authorized human chooses to manage that action from the reader
    Then the action is a deliberate user decision under the documented link and privacy policy
    And the scanner does not treat it as an editorial content fetch
  Scenario: Pause without pretending to unsubscribe
    Given a newsletter subscription delivers to a provided address
    When I pause its Monitor
    Then collection or processing follows the documented pause behavior
    And the UI does not report the external subscription as unsubscribed
    And unsubscribe remains a separate deliberate human action
```

New feature design, not an existing mailbox capability. Define safe readable original rendering, attachment/remote-image policy, access/retention, provenance navigation, status/error display and human action-link handling. Do not auto-fetch remote trackers, execute message instructions or leak secret-bearing links to classifiers/References. Full compose/reply mail-client functionality is out of scope unless separately requested. No address provisioning, subscription or link action now.

User-initiated unsubscribe acceptance is owned by PPY-bfcc3231-eceb-4b90-8d9b-de9990726b2e. A usable reader offers an explicitly clicked automated RFC 8058 HTTPS one-click flow where the message/header authentication and target requirements are met; it shows request/result/error status without claiming sender delivery has stopped. Without supported authenticated one-click, offer an appropriate external unsubscribe page for deliberate user action. Mailto-only limited outbound remains a design question, not a full mail client. Ingestion/link scanning never confirms or unsubscribes automatically; pause is not unsubscribe. This refines the earlier “manual management” wording: consent is manual, while a supported request may be automated after the user's click. Source: https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc8058 .
